domain: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) — SAP S/4HANA business application
summary: This is a comprehensive SAP S/4HANA enterprise resource planning system that manages end-to-end business processes for a mid-to-large sized organization. The application serves business users across procurement, sales, finance, manufacturing, logistics, and quality management functions, enabling them to execute and track critical business transactions from initial requisition through final payment and delivery. The system is built on SAP's Clean Core architecture principles, leveraging Core Data Services (CDS) for a semantic data layer and ABAP classes organized by business process domains. It provides integrated workflows across the procure-to-pay cycle (vendor management, purchasing, accounts payable), order-to-cash cycle (sales orders, billing, revenue recognition), financial accounting (general ledger, accounts receivable/payable), inventory management (warehouse operations, stock movements), master data governance (customers, vendors, materials, business partners), production planning and execution, quality inspections, pricing and discount calculations, and logistics coordination—all underpinning business intelligence and operational decision-making.

useCases.title: Create a sales order
useCases.description: Sales representative creates a new sales order for a customer, capturing order details, line items, pricing, and delivery requirements to initiate the order-to-cash process.
steps: Sales representative enters customer information and order header data
System validates customer creditworthiness and availability
Sales representative adds order line items with materials and quantities
Pricing engine calculates prices, discounts, and taxes
System reserves inventory for the order
Sales order is saved and confirmed with an order number

useCases.title: Generate customer invoice
useCases.description: Billing clerk generates an invoice for a completed sales order or delivery, posting revenue and accounts receivable entries to the financial system.
steps: Billing clerk selects delivered sales orders ready for invoicing
System retrieves order data, pricing, and delivery confirmation
Invoice document is generated with line items and totals
Financial postings are created in accounts receivable and revenue accounts
Invoice document is saved and transmitted to the customer
Payment terms and due dates are set based on customer agreement

useCases.title: Track sales order status
useCases.description: Sales manager monitors the status and progress of sales orders through the order-to-cash lifecycle, from creation through delivery and invoicing.
steps: Sales manager queries sales order by number or customer
System retrieves order header and line item details from database
Current status is displayed (created, confirmed, delivered, invoiced, paid)
Order fulfillment progress and open items are shown
Manager reviews delivery dates and payment status

useCases.title: Create a purchase order
useCases.description: Purchasing agent creates a purchase order from an approved requisition, selecting vendor, negotiating terms, and initiating the procurement process.
steps: Purchasing agent reviews and selects approved purchase requisitions
Vendor is selected based on pricing, terms, and availability
Purchase order header and line items are created with delivery dates
Pricing and payment terms are confirmed with the vendor
Purchase order is released and transmitted to the vendor
Commitment accounting entry is posted to reserve budget

useCases.title: Receive goods from vendor
useCases.description: Warehouse operator records the physical receipt of goods from a vendor, updates inventory levels, and triggers the invoice verification process.
steps: Warehouse operator scans or enters purchase order number
Delivered goods are verified against purchase order quantities
Goods receipt document is created for received items
Inventory stock levels are updated in the warehouse
Material valuation is posted to inventory and GR/IR accounts
Invoice verification is triggered for payment processing
useCases.evidence: PROCESS methods in procure-to-pay and inventory classes

useCases.title: Process vendor payment
useCases.description: Accounts payable clerk processes payment to a vendor for verified invoices, creating payment documents and clearing open payables.
steps: AP clerk selects vendor invoices due for payment
Payment method and bank details are confirmed
Payment run is executed for selected invoices
Payment documents are created and posted to accounts payable
Bank transfer or check is generated and transmitted
Open invoices are cleared and payment status is updated
useCases.evidence: PROCESS methods in procure-to-pay and finance classes

useCases.title: Post financial journal entries
useCases.description: Accountant posts manual journal entries to the general ledger for adjustments, accruals, reclassifications, and period-end closing activities.
steps: Accountant creates journal entry header with document date and posting period
Debit and credit line items are entered with GL accounts and amounts
Cost center, profit center, or other dimensions are assigned
System validates balanced debit/credit totals
Journal entry is posted to the general ledger
Financial balances and reports are updated in real-time

useCases.title: Generate financial reports
useCases.description: Financial controller generates balance sheets, income statements, and analytical reports for management review and regulatory compliance.
steps: Controller selects report type and reporting period
System retrieves general ledger balances and transaction data
Financial statements are generated with comparative periods
Cost center, profit center, and segment breakdowns are displayed
Reports are formatted for internal and external stakeholders
Controller exports or distributes reports to management
useCases.evidence: PROCESS methods in finance reporting classes

useCases.title: Process inventory stock movements
useCases.description: Warehouse operator records physical movements of materials between storage locations, plants, or reservation for production and sales orders.
steps: Operator selects movement type (transfer, issue, receipt, reservation)
Material, quantity, and source/target locations are entered
System validates stock availability and location capacity
Inventory movement document is created and posted
Stock quantities are updated in source and target locations
Material valuation and accounting entries are posted

useCases.title: Perform physical inventory count
useCases.description: Warehouse supervisor conducts periodic physical inventory counts to verify system stock quantities and identify discrepancies for adjustment.
steps: Supervisor creates physical inventory document for storage locations
Warehouse staff counts physical materials on hand
Counted quantities are entered into the system
System compares counted quantities to book inventory
Discrepancies are reviewed and approved for posting
Inventory adjustments are posted and stock balances corrected
useCases.evidence: PROCESS methods in inventory management classes

useCases.title: Maintain customer master data
useCases.description: Master data administrator creates and updates customer master records with contact information, credit limits, payment terms, and organizational assignments.
steps: Administrator creates new customer record or opens existing record
General data (name, address, contact details) is entered or updated
Sales area data (pricing, delivery terms, payment terms) is configured
Credit limit and risk category are assigned
System validates required fields and data consistency
Customer master record is saved and activated for transactions
useCases.evidence: MAINTAIN method in master data classes

useCases.title: Maintain vendor master data
useCases.description: Master data administrator creates and updates vendor master records with banking information, payment terms, purchasing organization assignments, and qualification status.
steps: Administrator creates new vendor record or opens existing record
General data (name, address, contact, tax ID) is entered or updated
Purchasing data (order currency, delivery terms, incoterms) is configured
Bank details and payment methods are maintained
System validates vendor qualification and compliance requirements
Vendor master record is saved and activated for procurement
useCases.evidence: MAINTAIN method in master data classes

useCases.title: Maintain material master data
useCases.description: Master data administrator creates and updates material master records with specifications, units of measure, valuation, and planning parameters across procurement, sales, and production views.
steps: Administrator creates new material record or opens existing record
Basic data (description, material type, units of measure) is entered
Purchasing data (order unit, vendor lead time, minimum order) is configured
Sales data (sales unit, availability check, delivery plant) is maintained
Inventory and accounting data (valuation, stock management) is set
Material master record is saved and activated across all views
useCases.evidence: MAINTAIN method in master data classes

useCases.title: Plan and execute shipment
useCases.description: Logistics coordinator plans shipments for sales orders, selects carriers, routes, and schedules deliveries to customers while optimizing transportation costs.
steps: Coordinator selects sales orders ready for shipment
Shipping point and route are determined based on delivery address
Carrier and transportation mode are selected
Shipment document is created with delivery dates and tracking
Picking and packing tasks are assigned to warehouse
Goods issue is posted and shipment is dispatched to customer

useCases.title: Manage inbound delivery
useCases.description: Logistics coordinator manages inbound deliveries from vendors, coordinating receipt appointments, unloading, and warehouse put-away activities.
steps: Coordinator receives advance shipping notice from vendor
Inbound delivery document is created from purchase order
Receiving dock appointment is scheduled
Goods are received, inspected, and unloaded at dock
Put-away tasks are created for warehouse placement
Goods receipt is confirmed and inventory is updated

useCases.title: Calculate sales pricing and discounts
useCases.description: System automatically calculates pricing for sales orders based on customer agreements, volume discounts, promotional campaigns, and condition records maintained by pricing administrators.
steps: Sales order is created with customer and material selection
Pricing engine retrieves base price from material master or agreement
Customer-specific discounts and surcharges are applied
Volume-based discounts are calculated from order quantities
Taxes, freight charges, and additional conditions are added
Final net price and total order value are determined and displayed

useCases.title: Maintain pricing conditions
useCases.description: Pricing administrator configures and maintains pricing condition records for base prices, discounts, surcharges, freight, and taxes used in sales and procurement calculations.
steps: Administrator selects condition type (price, discount, surcharge, tax)
Validity period and organizational level are defined
Condition records are created for materials, customers, or vendor combinations
Pricing scales and volume breaks are configured
System validates condition logic and precedence
Condition records are activated for pricing determination

useCases.title: Plan and create production order
useCases.description: Production planner creates production orders from demand forecasts or sales orders, scheduling manufacturing operations and reserving materials for production.
steps: Planner reviews material requirements from MRP or sales orders
Production order is created for finished good with target quantity
Bill of materials (BOM) is exploded to determine component requirements
Routing operations and work centers are scheduled
Material reservations are created for required components
Production order is released for execution on the shop floor

useCases.title: Confirm production operations
useCases.description: Production operator confirms completed manufacturing operations, recording actual quantities produced, labor hours consumed, and material usage on the shop floor.
steps: Operator selects production order and operation to confirm
Actual quantities produced are entered (yield and scrap)
Labor hours and machine time are recorded
Actual material consumption is confirmed or backflushed
Operation status is updated to completed
Costs are calculated and posted to the production order

useCases.title: Create quality inspection lot
useCases.description: Quality inspector creates inspection lots for incoming materials, in-process production, or finished goods to verify conformance to specifications and quality standards.
steps: Inspection lot is automatically triggered from goods receipt or production
Inspector selects inspection plan and characteristics to test
Sample size and sampling procedure are determined
Inspection lot is created with batch and material details
Usage decision is set to blocked pending inspection results
Inspector is notified to perform inspection tasks

useCases.title: Record inspection results and usage decision
useCases.description: Quality inspector records inspection results against quality specifications, makes accept/reject usage decisions, and releases or blocks materials based on test outcomes.
steps: Inspector retrieves open inspection lot and test specifications
Inspection characteristics are measured and results are recorded
System validates results against specification limits and tolerances
Defects and non-conformances are documented if found
Usage decision is made (accept, reject, or conditional release)
Stock status is updated to unrestricted, blocked, or quality inspection
Inspection lot is completed and quality certificate is generated if required
